lines: In different parts of the world, you can take special transportation.
You can take a gondola to travel around the city.
A gondola is a long and flat boat.
Its driver uses a long oar to move it.
India has narrow streets, but you can go through them with a rickshaw.
A rickshaw is a special bicycle with three wheels.
Its driver turns the pedals to move it.
Canada gets lots of snow in winter.
You can move on snow with a snowmobile.
Its skis in front help it slide on snow.
And its engine makes it move.

Its driver turns the pedals to move it. Canada gets lots of snow in winter. You can move on snow with a snowmobile. Its skis in front help it slide on snow. And its engine makes it move.
